name: qe-playground
description: QA practice application — React + Fastify playground for test automation training

scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: npm run kill:ports && concurrently "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.start: npm run kill:ports && concurrently "npm run start:server" "npm run dev:client"
